updates.name: EOH Update 2026-11-15 1213
updates.notes:
New: UPDATES on the title screen: patch notes for every update, and UPDATE NOW to install new ones (the game restarts by itself).
New: An UPDATE AVAILABLE card shows on the title screen when a new update is out, and WHAT'S NEW opens once after updating.
New: Your online name shows above your team's lifebars during online fights.
New: Quick Match asks for an online name the first time you use it (ONLINE menu or the training pause menu).
New: Quick Match on / off in the training pause menu: keep training while the game finds you an opponent.
New: WATCH > REPLAY has its own EOH-style replay list, with player names, dates and a BACK row for controllers.
Change: Online matches start as 3v3 Tag; Single and Tag 2 can still be picked.
Change: LOBBY is now above QUICK MATCH in the ONLINE menu.
Change: The online helper moved to its own "EOH Online" folder. Windows Firewall may ask about EOH Online.exe once: click Allow.
Change: Online play needs the latest update; the game offers to update when you pick an online mode.
Fix: Stopping Quick Match works properly.
